history.summary: IDENTITY UNCONFIRMED: no web source could be located for a 'Hanuman Temple' at Tadong despite targeted searches across place listings and temple directories - the generic name turns up unrelated shrines in West Bengal, Assam and elsewhere, none at Tadong. The best-known Hanuman shrine in the Gangtok area is Hanuman Tok (established 1952, maintained by the Indian Army, on the Gangtok-Nathula road ~11 km from Gangtok), a wish-fulfilling temple tied to the Sanjeevani legend - but that is a distinct, well-known site and NOT this row, so do not conflate them. This entry is a placeholder at Tadong town-centre coordinates (provisional, verify) pending local confirmation; content fields are deliberately minimal rather than invented. NOTE (2026-09-29): Sikkim temple listings (e.g. travalour.com's Sikkim Hindu-temples page, which covers Hanuman Tok near Gangtok) were consulted; no source documents a "Hanuman Temple" at Tadong - identity remains unconfirmed.

town_description: Tadong is a town just east of Gangtok on NH-10 (the Gangtok-Rangpo road) in Gangtok district, Sikkim, about 5 km from central Gangtok. It is a growing residential and commercial suburb of the capital with no widely documented Hanuman temple of its own in public sources.

travel.airport: Pakyong Airport (~18 km) or Bagdogra (~120 km, verify).
travel.road: On NH-10, the Gangtok-Rangpo road; taxis from Gangtok town (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published (verify - confirm the site's existence and timings locally before visiting). Visit the well-documented Hanuman Tok near Gangtok (6:00 AM-7:00 PM per travel guides) instead.
